description: Make an archive you did not build reproducible: canonicalize_zip rewrites it into the canonical deterministic form zipnative writes — entries sorted by raw name bytes, the DOS-epoch timestamp, UTF-8 flags, no extra field but Zip64, the constant version-made-by — WITHOUT recompressing a payload. summary.canonicalForm is the engine's own analyzeDeterminism() verdict on the output; running it again returns the same bytes (summary.alreadyCanonical). The entry comments and the archive comment are dropped unless keepComments: true.
